//! First-party local workload using actual public SDK/exporter/tracing adapter.
//! Snapshot is SDK SpanData plus a public proto-transform request, not wire capture.
use opentelemetry::{
    propagation::TextMapPropagator,
    trace::{
        Link, Span, SpanContext, SpanId, SpanKind, Status, TraceContextExt, TraceFlags, TraceId,
        TraceState, Tracer, TracerProvider,
    },
    Array, Context, InstrumentationScope, KeyValue, Value,
};
use opentelemetry_otlp::{Protocol, WithExportConfig, WithHttpConfig};
use opentelemetry_proto::{
    tonic::collector::trace::v1::ExportTraceServiceRequest,
    transform::{
        common::tonic::ResourceAttributesWithSchema,
        trace::tonic::group_spans_by_resource_and_scope,
    },
};
use opentelemetry_sdk::{
    error::OTelSdkResult,
    propagation::TraceContextPropagator,
    trace::{
        BatchConfigBuilder, BatchSpanProcessor, IdGenerator, Sampler, SdkTracer, SdkTracerProvider,
        SpanData, SpanExporter as Exporter,
    },
    Resource,
};
use prost::Message;
use serde_json::{json, Value as Json};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    fs,
    io::{Read, Write},
    net::{IpAddr, SocketAddr, TcpListener},
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},
        Arc, Mutex,
    },
    time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
};
use tracing_opentelemetry::OpenTelemetrySpanExt;
use tracing_subscriber::layer::SubscriberExt;

const QUEUE_SIZE: usize = 64;
const MAXIMUM_BATCH: usize = 64;
const SCHEDULED_DELAY_SECONDS: u64 = 86_400;

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Captures {
    spans: Vec<Json>,
    request: Vec<u8>,
    errors: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct CaptureExporter {
    inner: opentelemetry_otlp::SpanExporter,
    resource: Resource,
    capture: Arc<Mutex<Captures>>,
}
impl Exporter for CaptureExporter {
    async fn export(&self, batch: Vec<SpanData>) -> OTelSdkResult {
        {
            let mut capture = self.capture.lock().unwrap();
            capture
                .spans
                .extend(batch.iter().map(|s| snapshot(s, &self.resource)));
            let resource = ResourceAttributesWithSchema::from(&self.resource);
            let request = ExportTraceServiceRequest {
                resource_spans: group_spans_by_resource_and_scope(batch.clone(), &resource),
            };
            capture.request.extend(request.encode_to_vec());
        }
        let result = self.inner.export(batch).await;
        if let Err(error) = &result {
            self.capture.lock().unwrap().errors.push(error.to_string());
        }
        result
    }
    fn set_resource(&mut self, resource: &Resource) {
        self.resource = resource.clone();
        self.inner.set_resource(resource);
    }
    fn shutdown_with_timeout(&mut self, timeout: Duration) -> OTelSdkResult {
        self.inner.shutdown_with_timeout(timeout)
    }
    fn force_flush(&mut self) -> OTelSdkResult {
        self.inner.force_flush()
    }
}
#[derive(Debug)]
struct Ids(Arc<AtomicU64>);
impl IdGenerator for Ids {
    fn new_trace_id(&self) -> TraceId {
        TraceId::from_hex("0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f10").unwrap()
    }
    fn new_span_id(&self) -> SpanId {
        SpanId::from(self.0.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst))
    }
}
fn nanos(time: SystemTime) -> String {
    time.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .unwrap()
        .as_nanos()
        .to_string()
}
fn float(value: f64) -> String {
    if value.is_nan() {
        "NaN".into()
    } else if value == f64::INFINITY {
        "Infinity".into()
    } else if value == f64::NEG_INFINITY {
        "-Infinity".into()
    } else {
        value.to_string()
    }
}
fn any(value: &Value) -> Json {
    match value {
        Value::Bool(v) => json!({"boolValue": v}),
        Value::I64(v) => json!({"intValue": v.to_string()}),
        Value::F64(v) => json!({"doubleValue": float(*v)}),
        Value::String(v) => json!({"stringValue": v.as_str()}),
        Value::Array(v) => {
            let values: Vec<Json> = match v {
                Array::Bool(v) => v.iter().map(|v| any(&Value::Bool(*v))).collect(),
                Array::I64(v) => v.iter().map(|v| any(&Value::I64(*v))).collect(),
                Array::F64(v) => v.iter().map(|v| any(&Value::F64(*v))).collect(),
                Array::String(v) => v.iter().map(|v| any(&Value::String(v.clone()))).collect(),
                _ => panic!("fixture does not support this SDK array variant"),
            };
            json!({"arrayValue": {"values": values}})
        }
        _ => panic!("fixture does not support this SDK value variant"),
    }
}
fn attributes<'a>(values: impl Iterator<Item = (&'a opentelemetry::Key, &'a Value)>) -> Vec<Json> {
    values
        .map(|(key, value)| json!({"key": key.as_str(), "value": any(value)}))
        .collect()
}
fn attrs(values: &[KeyValue]) -> Vec<Json> {
    attributes(values.iter().map(|kv| (&kv.key, &kv.value)))
}
fn snapshot(s: &SpanData, r: &Resource) -> Json {
    let (status, message) = match &s.status {
        Status::Unset => (0, ""),
        Status::Ok => (1, ""),
        Status::Error { description } => (2, description.as_ref()),
    };
    let kind = match s.span_kind {
        SpanKind::Internal => 1,
        SpanKind::Server => 2,
        SpanKind::Client => 3,
        SpanKind::Producer => 4,
        SpanKind::Consumer => 5,
    };
    json!({
        "trace_id": s.span_context.trace_id().to_string(), "span_id": s.span_context.span_id().to_string(),
        "parent_id": if s.parent_span_id == SpanId::INVALID { String::new() } else { s.parent_span_id.to_string() },
        "parent_remote": s.parent_span_is_remote, "flags": s.span_context.trace_flags().to_u8(),
        "state": s.span_context.trace_state().header(), "name": s.name, "kind":kind,
        "start":nanos(s.start_time), "end":nanos(s.end_time), "status":status, "message":message,
        "resource":attributes(r.iter()), "resource_schema":r.schema_url().unwrap_or(""),
        "scope":{"name":s.instrumentation_scope.name(), "version":s.instrumentation_scope.version().unwrap_or(""),
          "schema":s.instrumentation_scope.schema_url().unwrap_or(""), "attributes":attrs(&s.instrumentation_scope.attributes().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>())},
        "attributes":attrs(&s.attributes), "dropped_attributes":s.dropped_attributes_count,
        "dropped_events":s.events.dropped_count, "dropped_links":s.links.dropped_count,
        "events":s.events.iter().map(|e| json!({"name":e.name,"time":nanos(e.timestamp),"attributes":attrs(&e.attributes),"dropped":e.dropped_attributes_count})).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        "links":s.links.iter().map(|l| json!({"trace_id":l.span_context.trace_id().to_string(),"span_id":l.span_context.span_id().to_string(),
          "state":l.span_context.trace_state().header(),"remote":l.span_context.is_remote(),"flags":l.span_context.trace_flags().to_u8(),
          "attributes":attrs(&l.attributes),"dropped":l.dropped_attributes_count})).collect::<Vec<_>>()
    })
}
// One owned, bounded, real HTTP/W3C service hop. This is not a Kura app bootstrap.
fn serve(listener: TcpListener, tracer: SdkTracer) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    let (mut stream, peer) = listener.accept().unwrap();
    assert!(peer.ip().is_loopback());
    stream
        .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(3)))
        .unwrap();
    stream
        .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(3)))
        .unwrap();
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    while !bytes.ends_with(b"\r\n\r\n") {
        assert!(bytes.len() < 4096, "HTTP evidence bound");
        let mut byte = [0];
        stream.read_exact(&mut byte).unwrap();
        bytes.push(byte[0]);
    }
    let request = String::from_utf8(bytes).unwrap();
    let mut lines = request.split("\r\n");
    assert_eq!(lines.next(), Some("GET /fixture HTTP/1.1"));
    let headers: HashMap<String, String> = lines
        .filter_map(|line| line.split_once(": "))
        .map(|(key, value)| (key.to_ascii_lowercase(), value.to_owned()))
        .collect();
    let remote_context = TraceContextPropagator::new().extract(&headers);
    assert!(remote_context.span().span_context().is_valid());
    let link_context = SpanContext::new(
        TraceId::from(99_u128),
        SpanId::from(99_u64),
        TraceFlags::SAMPLED,
        true,
        TraceState::from_key_value([("vendor", "opaque")]).unwrap(),
    );
    let mut server = tracer
        .span_builder("rust server")
        .with_kind(SpanKind::Server)
        .with_attributes([
            KeyValue::new("typed.int", 9_007_199_254_740_993_i64),
            KeyValue::new("typed.zero", -0.0_f64),
            KeyValue::new("typed.bool", true),
            KeyValue::new("http.route", "/fixture"),
            KeyValue::new("http.response.status_code", 503_i64),
            KeyValue::new("typed.nan", f64::NAN),
            KeyValue::new("typed.infinity", f64::INFINITY),
            KeyValue::new("typed.negative_infinity", f64::NEG_INFINITY),
            KeyValue::new(
                "typed.floats",
                Value::Array(Array::F64(vec![
                    f64::NAN,
                    f64::INFINITY,
                    f64::NEG_INFINITY,
                    -0.0,
                ])),
            ),
        ])
        .with_links(vec![Link::new(
            link_context,
            vec![
                KeyValue::new("link.int", 9_007_199_254_740_993_i64),
                KeyValue::new("link.bool", true),
            ],
            0,
        )])
        .start_with_context(&tracer, &remote_context);
    server.add_event(
        "rust event",
        vec![
            KeyValue::new("event.nan", f64::NAN),
            KeyValue::new("event.bool", true),
        ],
    );
    server.set_status(Status::error("fixture failure"));
    // A real local Span, not a remotely-labelled SpanContext, parents the adapter.
    let server_context = Context::new().with_span(server);
    let subscriber =
        tracing_subscriber::registry().with(tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer));
    tracing::subscriber::with_default(subscriber, || {
        let span = tracing::info_span!(
            "tracing adapter",
            task = "cache-read",
            answer = 9_007_199_254_740_993_i64
        );
        span.set_parent(server_context.clone()).unwrap();
        let _guard = span.enter();
        tracing::warn!(cache.hit = false, "cache miss");
    });
    server_context.span().end();
    stream
        .write_all(
            b"HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
        )
        .unwrap();
    headers
}
fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    if args.len() == 2 {
        let source: &[u8] = match args[1].as_str() {
            "--embedded-source" => include_bytes!("main.rs"),
            "--embedded-manifest" => include_bytes!("../Cargo.toml"),
            "--embedded-lock" => include_bytes!("../Cargo.lock"),
            "--embedded-build" => include_bytes!("../build.rs"),
            _ => panic!("unknown provenance request"),
        };
        std::io::stdout().write_all(source).unwrap();
        return;
    }
    assert_eq!(
        args.len(),
        5,
        "usage: producer http|http-env|grpc loopback-endpoint tenant output-prefix"
    );
    let (protocol, endpoint, tenant, output) = (&args[1], &args[2], &args[3], &args[4]);
    assert!(matches!(protocol.as_str(), "http" | "http-env" | "grpc"));
    // Parse only literal loopback addresses; no DNS, credentials or remote URLs.
    let address = endpoint
        .strip_prefix("http://")
        .expect("loopback http endpoint required");
    assert!(!address.contains(['?', '#', '\\']));
    let (authority, path) = address.split_once('/').unwrap_or((address, ""));
    if protocol == "grpc" {
        assert!(path.is_empty());
    } else {
        assert!(
            path.ends_with("v1/traces")
                && path
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"/-_".contains(&b))
        );
    }
    let socket: SocketAddr = authority.parse().expect("literal loopback socket required");
    assert!(IpAddr::is_loopback(&socket.ip()) && socket.port() != 0);
    assert!(
        !tenant.is_empty()
            && tenant.len() <= 64
            && tenant
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-')
    );
    let runtime = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .worker_threads(2)
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    // Build blocking HTTP client outside a Tokio-entered thread; tonic requires
    // a live runtime. This component fixture is not the actual Kura bootstrap.
    let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::builder()
        .no_proxy()
        .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    let inner = if protocol != "grpc" {
        let builder = opentelemetry_otlp::SpanExporter::builder()
            .with_http()
            .with_endpoint(endpoint)
            .with_protocol(Protocol::HttpBinary)
            .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))
            .with_http_client(client.clone());
        let builder = if protocol == "http" {
            builder.with_headers(HashMap::from([
                ("authorization".into(), format!("Bearer token-{tenant}")),
                ("x-scope-orgid".into(), tenant.clone()),
            ]))
        } else {
            builder
        };
        builder.build().unwrap()
    } else {
        let _enter = runtime.enter();
        opentelemetry_otlp::SpanExporter::builder()
            .with_tonic()
            .with_endpoint(endpoint)
            .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))
            .build()
            .unwrap()
    };
    let resource = Resource::builder_empty()
        .with_schema_url(
            [
                KeyValue::new("service.name", "rust-bridge"),
                KeyValue::new("service.namespace", "example"),
                KeyValue::new("deployment.environment.name", tenant.clone()),
                KeyValue::new("typed.int", 9_007_199_254_740_993_i64),
                KeyValue::new("resource.bool", true),
                KeyValue::new("resource.zero", -0.0_f64),
                KeyValue::new("resource.nan", f64::NAN),
            ],
            "https://example.test/resource/1.0",
        )
        .build();
    let capture = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Captures::default()));
    // Explicit flush profile: never race the default five-second scheduler.
    // The process is owned with a <=30s await; this delay is not Kura's default.
    let processor = BatchSpanProcessor::builder(CaptureExporter {
        inner,
        resource: resource.clone(),
        capture: capture.clone(),
    })
    .with_batch_config(
        BatchConfigBuilder::default()
            .with_max_queue_size(QUEUE_SIZE)
            .with_max_export_batch_size(MAXIMUM_BATCH)
            .with_scheduled_delay(Duration::from_secs(SCHEDULED_DELAY_SECONDS))
            .build(),
    )
    .build();
    let provider = SdkTracerProvider::builder()
        .with_sampler(Sampler::ParentBased(Box::new(Sampler::TraceIdRatioBased(
            1.0,
        ))))
        .with_id_generator(Ids(Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(1))))
        .with_max_attributes_per_event(1)
        .with_max_attributes_per_link(1)
        .with_resource(resource.clone())
        .with_span_processor(processor)
        .build();
    let scope = InstrumentationScope::builder("sdk-bridge")
        .with_version("0.31.0")
        .with_schema_url("https://example.test/scope/1.0")
        .with_attributes([
            KeyValue::new("scope.enabled", true),
            KeyValue::new("scope.zero", -0.0_f64),
            KeyValue::new("scope.nan", f64::NAN),
        ])
        .build();
    let tracer = provider.tracer_with_scope(scope);
    let mut root = tracer
        .span_builder("rust client")
        .with_kind(SpanKind::Client)
        .start(&tracer);
    root.set_status(Status::Ok);
    let root_context = Context::new().with_span(root);
    let propagator = TraceContextPropagator::new();
    let mut headers = HashMap::new();
    propagator.inject_context(&root_context, &mut headers);
    headers.insert("tracestate".into(), "vendor=opaque".into());
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let target = format!("http://{}/fixture", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
    let worker = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("fixture-service".into())
        .spawn(move || serve(listener, tracer))
        .unwrap();
    let mut request = client.get(target);
    for (key, value) in &headers {
        request = request.header(key, value);
    }
    assert_eq!(request.send().unwrap().status().as_u16(), 503);
    let received_headers = worker.join().unwrap(); // all child on_end calls completed
    assert_eq!(
        received_headers.get("traceparent"),
        headers.get("traceparent")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        received_headers.get("tracestate"),
        headers.get("tracestate")
    );
    root_context.span().end();
    let flush = provider.force_flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string());
    let shutdown = provider.shutdown().map_err(|e| e.to_string());
    let capture = capture.lock().unwrap();
    fs::write(format!("{output}-sdk.protobuf"), &capture.request).unwrap();
    fs::write(format!("{output}-oracle.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({
        "sdk":"rust opentelemetry_sdk 0.31.0 / opentelemetry-otlp 0.31.1 / tracing-opentelemetry 0.32.1",
        "batch_profile":{"queue":QUEUE_SIZE,"maximum_batch":MAXIMUM_BATCH,"scheduled_delay_ms":SCHEDULED_DELAY_SECONDS * 1000},
        "protocol":protocol,"spans":capture.spans,"export_errors":capture.errors,"flush":flush.err(),"shutdown":shutdown.err(),
        "propagation":headers,"received_headers":received_headers,"http_hop_status":503,
        "rustc":env!("PULSE_FIXTURE_RUSTC"),"target":env!("PULSE_FIXTURE_TARGET")
    })).unwrap()).unwrap();
}
